steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The brain has four lobes: Frontal (planning, decision-making, personality, motor control), Parietal (sensory processing, spatial awareness), Temporal (hearing, language comprehension, memory), Occipital (visual processing). Each lobe has specialised functions (localisation of function). | Key Fact: The cerebral cortex is the outer layer of the brain responsible for higher-order functions: thinking, language, memory, perception and consciousness. It is divided into two hemispheres connected by the corpus callosum. | Key Fact: Language areas: Broca's area (left frontal lobe) - speech production.
